observations.label: duplicate-create-entries
observations.caution: These are duplicate identical target regions, not multiple distinct target replicas; distinct multi-create remains unsampled.

observations.label: source-transition
observations.result: CreateTable started CREATING. Replica creation response UPDATING immediately exposed GlobalTableVersion 2019.11.21 and NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES Streams; settled replicas list contains only the other region. MultiRegionConsistency omitted in sampled descriptions.

observations.label: tag-independence
observations.result: Replica starts with no tags; assigning replica scope tag does not change source tags.

observations.label: pitr-independence
observations.result: Early source enable hit ContinuousBackupsUnavailableException. Later source-only enable succeeded while replica remained DISABLED. PITR disabled and verified in both regions before cleanup.

observations.label: on-demand-read-override
observations.result: Provisioned read override on PAY_PER_REQUEST rejected. On-demand read/write maxima synchronize. Replica-only max-read override changes east2 to 10 while source stays 20. Later source maxima 30 read/25 write resets replica override and both converge to 30/25.

observations.label: ttl-synchronization
observations.result: Enabling TTL attribute expires on source was observed ENABLED on both replicas; no expiring items written.

observations.label: removal-and-standalone
observations.result: Source deletion refused while other replica existed because it acted as a source in last 24h. Removing east2 succeeded. Remaining source lost GlobalTableVersion and Replicas; Streams stayed enabled, then could be disabled. Initial copied item remained on source. Source deletion then succeeded without waiting 24h and both regions returned ResourceNotFoundException.

observations.label: narrow-role-authorization-limit
observations.result: All three immediate temporary-role sessions returned AccessDeniedException naming UpdateTable and no identity-based allow, despite narrow inline policy submission success. No stabilized-role baseline obtained; IAM propagation or another policy layer is unresolved. This does NOT establish CreateTableReplica dependency or source/destination ARN semantics.

limitations: Sampled version-2019 MREC only; legacy and MRSC remain unsampled, not excluded from service scope.
No concurrent-write conflict or latency guarantee is inferred from bounded observations.
No provisioned capacity or GSI was created; GSI read overrides and provisioned synchronization remain unsampled.
The DynamoDB replication service-linked role existed before the probe and had the same RoleId afterward; it was not created, deleted or modified.

Additional requested IAM dependency probe ran after owned tables were deleted. Narrow role/session UpdateTable calls target the absent owned source; missing-table and role propagation precedence prevent treating those responses as an existing-table CreateTableReplica authorization contract.

The experiment was limited to east1/east2. Multiple distinct remote replica creations in one call were not attempted. Duplicate identical Create entries succeeded; this does not establish distinct multi-replica admission.
PITR enable before replica creation was rejected during continuous-backup initialization; source-PITR inheritance at initial creation remains unsampled. Post-creation PITR independence was observed.
Temporary role policy propagation was not established; IAM failures identify UpdateTable, not CreateTableReplica. No dependent-action/resource ARN conclusion is supported.
No IAM policy/role/organization/logging configuration that existed before the probe was modified. The explicitly requested newly owned IAM role and inline policy were deleted.

replicaCreation.note: Two identical Create entries were accepted in one request; no separate replica creation call issued.
